comments.author: @heatherk.4956
comments.text: I started milling my own wheat that I buy in 25lb bags, and making all our bread and baked goods. Not only does it taste amazing it’s filling and so good for you. My coworker who ate some of my fresh milled chocolate chip cookies was amazed they didn’t spike his blood sugar. If milling your flour is intimidating start by just buying real good quality flour (preferably whole grain) and making your bread at home. I also have started cooking organic dried beans once a week, and buy all my fruit and veggies from local markets that source local real organic produce. The difference in the produce is amazing. I order my meat and cheese from reputable sources and my whole chickens from Mennonite/amish farmers and buy raw milk produced in my state. I buy eggs from my neighbor. Yes a lot of these things cost more but I don’t buy highly-processed or premade foods any longer which are very expensive when you think about it, and now I control the ingredients. It’s made a huge impact on our health my husband even has fewer migraines now. They are messing with the food and have been for a long time.
